venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Friday 8/7.** MOD Mkz / JK. Net $6,791 vs $5,994 target (+13.3%). Food $766, comps $168, 258 guests, $26.33 check avg. Quiet start with a few familiar regulars; calm flow into the evening with DJ from 9pm and a big high-energy pop around 11pm. Opener cut ~9:30pm, mid stayed to close. Kitchen busy with great ticket times. 86'd Ocho Repo, Arette Repo, Don Fulano Anejo. Favorite moment: Andre Mac, a som with a big YouTube following, came in and praised the atmosphere. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 8/7.** MOD KK/KE & JMS. Net $9,267 vs $9,911 target (-6.5%). Food $308, comps $57.10 (0.6%), ~331 guests, $28.00 check avg. Slow start (~$650 by 7pm); coordinated with Lovetrain Antiques' album-release show upstairs and pushed the DJ to 10pm to avoid sound conflict. Main pop at 10pm, drop-off at 11pm, then a strong ~$800 pop after 1am when Charmers closed. Regular Friday crowd, vibes on point. NOTE: an incident occurred — see Kira & Kala. No-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 8/7.** AM Maggie S & Chef Josh; PM Evan F & Chef Lucas. Net $20,833.52 incl. events vs $19,432 target (+7.2%). AM $1,029.32, PM $17,152.40, Garden/6A $5,151.28; food $4,696 incl. events; net event sales $2,590 (intimate b-day dinner for AJ in Suite 6A, 6:30-9:30pm — Lucas W's family-style spread a hit, group thanked the team). Comps $578.65 (~3.17%), 376 guests (Tock). Busy night handled well: in-house event, bumpin' garden, ebb-and-flow lobby, a few IRDs, minimal service recoveries. Kitchen busy but got it done. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 8/7.** MOD Gigi/Joe & Josh/Saleh. Net $11,172 vs $11,713 target (-4.6%). Food $1,849; Standing Room $2,414 / Marquee $8,757; comps $258.74; 321 guests. Mellow start — area concerts/events kept people away — picked up ~8pm, both rooms full closer to 9pm. Members Leah and Vincent in with parties of 4; lots of first-timers. Closed SR at 11pm and consolidated into Marquee; small midnight pop. Ariana trained as 3rd host with Gracy and Natalie. Lots of service compliments. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 8/7.** AM Braden & Lex; PM Justin & Marcus/Drew. Net $10,463 vs $11,500 target (-9.0%). Municipal Bar AM $1,040 / PM $7,352; Sun Club $501; Hot Eye $1,571; food $3,209; comps $239; guests 39 AM + 207 PM (OpenTable). Quiet morning picking up after 2pm. Evening never slammed but nice and steady — many large-party reservations, good flow state from 8pm to close. Hot Eye nearly full ~9pm, lull 10-11:30, late-night industry crowd at the end; Seba's last shift in THE. Kitchen busier than recent nights; one expired bag of mussels wasted. No incidents. (Report form typed 'Saturday' but date/post time confirm Friday 8/7.)
